integrity: The symbolic simplex-sum facet-distance derivation is correct for all n>=2. The singleton constraints give the sharp global radius and unique center; the positive-integer tube-density inequality controls all larger facets, with an equality exception in dimension two. Finite calculations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The formulas are specific to the translation-normalized standard Minkowski-sum stellohedron and the intrinsic Euclidean metric. They follow directly from the general positive-integer density comparison and singleton-facet inball proof in the published complete-bipartite graph-associahedron result; its main theorem excludes the star boundary but its lemma covers it. The two public mathematical records have the same listed 2026-10-11 date, with no within-day precedence established.
title: Exact Euclidean inradius and unique uniform incenter of the standard stellohedron
